info.name: Tron Energy API by TronZap.com
info.description:
Postman collection for [Tron energy rental](https://tronzap.com/) service by TronZap.com. For more details, please visit the official [Tron Energy API Documentation](https://docs.tronzap.com/). ## Obtaining API Credentials To get started with the TronZap API, you'll need to obtain your API credentials from the dashboard: 1. Log in to your [TronZap Dashboard](https://dash.tronzap.com/api) 2. Navigate to the **API section** 3. Copy your **API Token** and **API Secret** # Tron Energy FAQ ## Why do I need TRX energy? How can I reduce USDT transfer fees? Energy significantly reduces fees for USDT transfers (TRC-20 on the TRON blockchain). Without energy, a typical USDT transfer costs around **13.40 TRX**. With energy, this fee drops to approximately **3.70 TRX**. ## How is the USDT transfer fee calculated on TRON? The TRON network first uses available energy in your account. If you don’t have enough energy, TRX tokens from your balance will be burned instead. - A standard USDT (TRC-20) transfer requires **65,000 energy**. - If the recipient has never held USDT or has an inactive account, the transfer will require **131,000 energy**. We recommend purchasing **131,000 energy** to guarantee your USDT transactions complete smoothly and avoid additional blockchain fees. You can use the [Estimate Tron Energy](https://docs.tronzap.com/api/estimate-energy.html) method from our API to estimate the amount of energy required for a USDT transaction. ## What is TronZap? **TronZap** is a reliable platform for [renting TRX energy](https://tronzap.com/) on the TRON blockchain, ensuring fast and secure transactions. ## What should I do if my energy doesn’t appear after payment? Reach out directly to our support via Telegram [@tronzap_support_bot](https://t.me/tronzap_support_bot) Although we use powerful servers and a global CDN, blockchain delays - though extremely rare (about 1 in a million) - can occasionally occur. ## Can I track my payments through a dashboard? Yes! TronZap provides a personalized dashboard where you can monitor your energy purchases and transaction history. Simply register [Tron Energy Account](https://tronzap.com/) to access all your data and manage your energy rentals conveniently from one place. ## Do you have Tron Energy SDK? #### Tron Energy PHP SDK ``` bash composer require tron-energy-market/tronzap-sdk-php ``` _GitHub Repository:_ [https://github.com/tron-energy-market/tronzap-sdk-php](https://github.com/tron-energy-market/tronzap-sdk-php) _Packagist:_[
https://packagist.org/packages/tron-energy-market/tronzap-sdk-php](https://packagist.org/packages/tron-energy-market/tronzap-sdk-php) #### Tron Energy Node.js SDK _GitHub Repository:_ [https://github.com/tron-energy-market/tronzap-sdk-nodejs](https://github.com/tron-energy-market/tronzap-sdk-nodejs) _Tron Energy npm Package:_ [https://www.npmjs.com/package/tronzap-sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tronzap-sdk) ``` bash npm install tronzap-sdk // or yarn add tronzap-sdk // or pnpm add tronzap-sdk ``` #### Tron Energy Python SDK ``` bash pip install tronzap-sdk ``` _GitHub Repository:_ [https://github.com/tron-energy-market/tronzap-sdk-python](https://github.com/tron-energy-market/tronzap-sdk-python) _Tron Energy PyPI Package:_ [https://pypi.org/project/tronzap-sdk/](https://pypi.org/project/tronzap-sdk/)
